description: The member of Maid For You responsible primarily for domestic duties. She can almost always be seen with a permanent smile on her face, which never fades even when she makes the occasional mistake at work. This indefatigable cheeriness is infectious to those who hang around Soda.

lines.text: Everyone is happy when things are spick and span.
Of all the household chores, I'm best at cleaning!
Maid for you♪ Maid for you♪ Meet the maid especially for you♪ What do you think? Did that put you in a better mood?
No matter how much I scrub them, these pesky spots are still on the window...
Here, put your head on my lap so I can clean your ears... Oh, wait... then I won't be able to see your cute little face!
I should tidy the place up while Master is asleep!
Hehe, sleeping again... let's see if this will wake Master up...
I found a place to clean!
Master, do you want to stop by the Maid Cafe? I can give you a massage.
I like this place! Everyone looks so happy here.
I just want everyone to be happy.
Does this mean I won't get into as many accidents?
Huh...? Are you giving it to me? Wow!
I want to do something in return, but I'm not sure what you like.
I feel like you always give me gifts, but I never return the favor. Are you sure that's okay?
All I want is for Master to be as happy as I am!
I like you so, so much, Master!
I want to be your personal maid, Master!
Just look at this mess! Better start cleaning.
Nothing like a good cleaning, am I right?
